AddInstanceWhiteList.title: Add instance IP/VPCID whitelist
AddInstanceWhiteList.summary: Adds an instance whitelist. Only new-architecture instances are supported, that is, instances whose VPC access point (or VPC PrivateLink access point) ends with mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com.

CreateAccount.title: CreateAccount
CreateAccount.summary: When an open-source client accesses an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ server, it must provide a username and password for authentication. ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ lets you generate a username and password from an AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret provided by Resource Access Management (RAM).

CreateBinding.title: CreateBinding
CreateBinding.summary: A producer sends a message to an exchange, which then routes the message to a specified queue or another exchange based on the binding and routing rules.

CreateExchange.title: CreateExchange
CreateExchange.summary: A producer sends a message to an exchange. The exchange then routes the message to one or more queues based on the routing key and the binding key, or discards the message.

CreateInstance.title: Create an instance
CreateInstance.summary: Creates an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance.

CreateOpenSourceAccount.title: Create open-source username and password
CreateOpenSourceAccount.summary: Creates an open-source username and password.

CreateQueue.title: CreateQueue
CreateQueue.summary: A queue is a buffer that stores messages. In ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ, messages are sent to a specified exchange and then routed to a bound queue.

CreateVirtualHost.title: CreateVirtualHost
CreateVirtualHost.summary: Creates a vhost. A vhost is used to logically isolate resources. Each vhost manages its own exchanges, queues, and bindings. Applications can run on independent vhosts in a secure manner. This way, the business of an application is not affected by other applications. Before you connect producers and consumers to an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance, you must specify vhosts for the producers and consumers.

DeleteAccount.title: DeleteAccount
DeleteAccount.summary: Deletes a static username and password.

DeleteBinding.title: DeleteBinding
DeleteBinding.summary: The DeleteBinding operation detaches a source exchange from a target queue or another exchange.

DeleteInstance.title: Delete an instance
DeleteInstance.summary: Deletes an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance.

DeleteOpenSourceAccount.title: Delete open-source username and password
DeleteOpenSourceAccount.summary: Deletes the username and password of an open-source user.

GetInstance.title: GetInstance
GetInstance.summary: Retrieves the details of an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance.

GetMetadataAmount.title: GetMetadataAmount
GetMetadataAmount.summary: Queries the current and maximum numbers of vhosts, exchanges, and queues for a specified ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance.

ListAccounts.title: ListAccounts
ListAccounts.summary: Lists the usernames and passwords for a specified ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance.

ListBindings.title: ListBindings
ListBindings.summary: Queries all bindings that are created in a vhost of a specified ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance.

ListDownStreamBindings.title: ListDownStreamBindings
ListDownStreamBindings.summary: Queries the exchanges or queues that are bound to a specified exchange.

ListExchangeUpStreamBindings.title: ListExchangeUpStreamBindings
ListExchangeUpStreamBindings.summary: Queries the queues or other exchanges that are bound to a specified exchange.

ListExchanges.title: ListExchanges
ListExchanges.summary: Lists all exchanges in a specified vhost of an instance.

ListInstanceWhiteList.title: Query instance IP/VPC ID values
ListInstanceWhiteList.summary: Queries the IP or VPC whitelist of an instance. Only new-architecture instances are supported, that is, instances whose VPC access point (or VPC PrivateLink access point) ends with mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com.

ListInstances.title: ListInstances
ListInstances.summary: Queries a list of ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instances in a specified region and returns basic information about each instance, such as its endpoints and specification limits.

ListQueueConsumers.title: ListQueueConsumers
ListQueueConsumers.summary: Queries the online consumer clients of a specified queue.

ListQueueUpStreamBindings.title: ListQueueUpStreamBindings
ListQueueUpStreamBindings.summary: Queries the exchanges that are bound to a specified queue.

ListQueues.title: ListQueues
ListQueues.summary: Queries information about all queues in a vhost on a specified ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance.

ListVirtualHosts.title: ListVirtualHosts
ListVirtualHosts.summary: Lists all vhosts in a specified ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance.

RemoveInstanceWhiteList.title: Delete IP/VPCID whitelist
RemoveInstanceWhiteList.summary: Deletes an IP or VPC whitelist entry for an instance. This operation supports only new-architecture instances whose VPC access points (or VPC PrivateLink access points) end with mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com.

UpdateInstance.title: Update an instance
UpdateInstance.summary: Updates an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance to upgrade or downgrade its specifications.

UpdateInstanceName.title: UpdateInstanceName
UpdateInstanceName.summary: An ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance is named after its instance ID by default. You can change the name for easier identification.

UpdateInstanceServerlessSwitch.title: Update the elastic switch of a serverless instance

UpdateOpenSourceAccount.title: Update open-source username and password
UpdateOpenSourceAccount.summary: Updates the username and password for open-source access.
